import fs from'node:fs';import assert from'node:assert/strict';import{JSDOM}from'../../ui-recogito-adapt/node_modules/jsdom/lib/api.js';import{composePreview}from'../../ui-vault-550/apps/atlas-sample/preview-runtime.mjs';
const p=new URL('.',import.meta.url).pathname,read=n=>fs.readFileSync(p+'delivery/'+n,'utf8'),css=read('runtime.css');assert(!/@font-face|https?:\/\/(?!www.w3.org)/.test(css));assert(!/base64/.test(css));assert(css.includes('border-image-source: url('));const dom=new JSDOM(composePreview(read('index.html'),css,read('runtime.js'),{cssHref:'runtime.css',scriptSrc:'runtime.js'}),{runScripts:'dangerously'});const w=dom.window,d=w.document,stage=d.getElementById('stage'),dark=d.getElementById('dark'),direction=d.getElementById('direction');let states=0;for(const theme of[false,true])for(const value of['','from-left','from-right']){dark.checked=theme;direction.value=value;direction.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));const balloon=stage.querySelector('.nes-balloon');assert.equal(balloon.textContent.trim(),'Hello NES.css');assert.equal(balloon.classList.contains('is-dark'),theme);assert.equal(balloon.classList.contains('from-left'),value==='from-left');assert.equal(balloon.classList.contains('from-right'),value==='from-right');states++}let before=stage.innerHTML;d.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('visibilitychange'));assert.equal(stage.innerHTML,before);w.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('atlas:dispose'));assert(dark.disabled&&direction.disabled);dark.checked=false;dark.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('change'));assert.equal(stage.innerHTML,before);w.dispatchEvent(new w.Event('pagehide'));dom.window.close();console.log(JSON.stringify({actual550Compose:true,originalStates:states,nativeControls:true,hiddenStaticPreserved:true,exitDisablesControlsAndOldEventsInert:true,noNetworkFontsOrBinaryAssets:true,visualQA:'not-run'},null,2));
